meta.name: elimination-research
meta.description: This skill should be used for elimination-style research where the user wants to choose from a shortlist of products, tools, services, vendors, or other options using explicit criteria, numeric evidence, tournament-style comparison, source/domain classification, image-supported consumer reports, raw data tables, and ownership-cost estimates for replaceable parts. Use this skill whenever the user asks to compare options, buy something, shortlist candidates, rank alternatives, generate a "don't make me think" report, or produce a full audit report with raw numeric data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从候选列表中帮你选出最优选项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个产品、工具或服务中做选择
copy.tagline_en: Choose the best option from a shortlist
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make a choice among multiple products, tools, or services

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将你的“选哪个”请求转化为标准化淘汰研究：生成候选名单、评分表格、消费者报告、审计报告、原始数据和购买链接。
howto.when: 当你要求比较选项、购买商品、筛选候选、排名或生成带数据的审计报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我比较三款无线耳机，按音质、续航和价格评分。
say.note: Claude 会开始询问具体标准并生成报告。

say.text: 我要买一台洗衣机，预算3000元，列出候选并给出推荐。
say.note: Claude 会收集限制条件并产出淘汰研究包。

say.text: 生成一份电动牙刷的全套淘汰研究报告，包含原始数据表格。
say.note: Claude 会输出所有报告文件（HTML、JSON等）。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude transforms "which one should I choose?" requests into a standardized elimination research package: shortlist dataset, numeric scoring model, consumer report, audit report, raw data JSON, and purchase links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to compare options, buy something, shortlist candidates, rank alternatives, or generate a data-heavy audit report.

say_en.text: Compare three wireless earphones by sound quality, battery life, and price.
say_en.note: Claude will ask intake questions and generate the report.

say_en.text: I want to buy a washing machine, budget ¥3000, list candidates and recommend.
say_en.note: Claude will collect constraints and produce an elimination research package.

say_en.text: Generate a full elimination research report for electric toothbrushes, with raw data tables.
say_en.note: Claude will output all report files (HTML, JSON, etc.).
